chunks: When Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, intended to create the earth, He commanded the four winds, and they struck the surface of the water until it became waves. Then it produced foam, which became a single mass of foam. He gathered it in the place of the House, then made it a mountain of foam. Then He spread out the earth from beneath it, and this is the saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic:
"Indeed, the first House established for mankind was surely the one at Bakkah, blessed."
So the first spot created from the earth was the Ka'bah, then the earth was extended from it.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abu Ja'far, Imam Muhammad ibn 'Ali al-Baqir عليه السلام
key_terms.الرِّيَاحَ الْأَرْبَعَ: the four winds commanded during the creation process
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةُ: the Ka'bah, the first spot of earth mentioned in the narration
key_terms.بِبَكَّةَ: Bakkah, the sacred location of the Ka'bah in Makkah
key_terms.مَتْنَ الْمَاءِ: the surface or upper expanse of the water

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain the Ka'bah as the first part of the earth to be created?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the origin of the earth in relation to the Ka'bah, presenting it as the first point from which the earth was spread out. It also cites the Qur'anic verse about the House at Bakkah to highlight the blessed and primordial status of the Ka'bah in creation and worship.
